sentences.en: From The New York Times, I'm Natalie Kittrow-F.
sentences.zh: 我是来自《纽约时报》的娜塔莉·基特罗夫-F。

sentences.en: This is The Daily.

sentences.en: Last week, financial markets went into a panic over an obscure Chinese tech startup called DeepSeek.
sentences.zh: 上周，金融市场因一家名为DeepSeek的无名中国科技初创公司而陷入恐慌。

sentences.en: That company now threatens to upend the world of artificial intelligence and the race for who will dominate it.
sentences.zh: 这家公司现在威胁要颠覆人工智能世界以及关于谁将主导这一领域的竞赛。

sentences.en: Today, my colleague Kevin Roos, a tech columnist and the co-host of the podcast Hard Fork, on how DeepSeek caught us all off guard.
sentences.zh: 今天，我的同事凯文·罗斯，一位科技专栏作家兼播客《硬分叉》的联合主持人，将为我们讲述DeepSeek是如何让我们所有人措手不及的。

sentences.en: It's Monday, February 3rd.
sentences.zh: 今天是2月3日，星期一。

sentences.en: Hi, Kevin.
sentences.zh: 嗨，凯文。

sentences.en: Hello.
sentences.zh: 你好。

sentences.en: So great to be here.
sentences.zh: 很高兴来到这里。

sentences.en: So let's jump in.
sentences.zh: 那我们开始吧。

sentences.en: Kevin, how did this giant AI tech freakout begin?
sentences.zh: 凯文，这场巨大的AI科技恐慌是如何开始的？

sentences.en: Tell us that story.
sentences.zh: 给我们讲讲这个故事。

sentences.en: So the freakout really started in earnest with a Chinese AI company called DeepSeek.
sentences.zh: 所以，这场恐慌确实是从一家名为DeepSeek的中国AI公司开始的。

sentences.en: And DeepSeek had released a new AI model.
sentences.zh: DeepSeek发布了一个新的AI模型。

sentences.en: You know, models are released all the time.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，模型一直在发布。

sentences.en: Generally, they don't make international news.
sentences.zh: 通常它们不会成为国际新闻。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: But this model was different in a few ways.
sentences.zh: 但这个模型在几个方面有所不同。

sentences.en: DeepSeek released its new chatbot app, which is said to perform as well as chat GPT.
sentences.zh: DeepSeek发布了其新的聊天机器人应用，据称其表现与ChatGPT不相上下。

sentences.en: One of them was that it just appeared to be a really good model, like better than the leading Chinese models at the time,
sentences.zh: 其中一点在于，它看起来确实是一个非常好的模型，比如比当时领先的中国模型要好，

sentences.en: and on par or close to on par with the leading American models.
sentences.zh: 并且与美国领先的模型处于同一水平或接近同一水平。

sentences.en: A new AI king was crowned today, well, at least for now.
sentences.zh: 一个新的AI之王今天加冕了，好吧，至少目前是这样。

sentences.en: And so the DeepSeek app...
sentences.zh: 所以DeepSeek应用……

sentences.en: Unseating open AI's chat GPT...
sentences.zh: 取代了OpenAI的ChatGPT……

sentences.en: ...goes to number one on the App Store charts.
sentences.zh: ……冲上了应用商店排行榜的第一名。

sentences.en: It vaults ahead of chat GPT and all these better known apps.
sentences.zh: 它超越了ChatGPT以及所有这些更知名的应用。

sentences.en: Now, the most stunning thing here isn't necessarily that China has developed a pretty good AI app.
sentences.zh: 现在，最让人震惊的倒不见得是中国开发了一款相当不错的AI应用。

sentences.en: It's how cheap it is.
sentences.zh: 而是它有多便宜。

sentences.en: And the more notable thing, the thing that really caused the American AI industry to start to panic, was how cheaply this model appeared to have been built.
sentences.zh: 更值得注意的是，真正让美国AI行业开始恐慌的是，这个模型的构建成本似乎非常低廉。

sentences.en: How cheap are we talking?
sentences.zh: 我们指的是多便宜？

sentences.en: So we think that this model cost DeepSeek about $5.5 million to train.
sentences.zh: 所以我们认为训练这个模型花费了DeepSeek大约550万美元。

sentences.en: Now, that might sound like a lot of money, but it's really not compared to what many of the American AI companies are spending.
sentences.zh: 现在，这听起来可能是一大笔钱，但与许多美国AI公司正在花费的资金相比，真的不算什么。

sentences.en: Meta said that it was spending...
sentences.zh: Meta曾表示它将花费……

sentences.en: ...65 billion dollars.
...65 billion dollars.
Microsoft says it plans to spend about $80 billion.
sentences.zh: 微软表示计划花费大约800亿美元。

sentences.en: Microsoft said it was spending $80 billion.
sentences.zh: 微软表示它将花费800亿美元。

sentences.en: ...and some of the world's most prominent technology leaders pledging to invest an initial $100 billion.
sentences.zh: ……并且一些全球最知名的科技领袖承诺初步投资1000亿美元。

sentences.en: And OpenAI had just announced this giant partnership where they were planning to spend...
sentences.zh: OpenAI刚刚宣布了一项巨大的合作计划，他们计划花费……

sentences.en: ...up to half a trillion over the next four years.
sentences.zh: ……在未来四年内高达数千亿美元。

sentences.en: ...as much as half a trillion dollars to build the infrastructure for AI.
sentences.zh: ……多达五千亿美元来构建AI基础设施。

sentences.en: Whoa.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: Yeah, it's wild.
sentences.zh: 是的，太疯狂了。

sentences.en: And on top of that, DeepSeek says that they built their model without access to the latest and greatest American AI chips,
sentences.zh: 最重要的是，DeepSeek表示他们在构建模型时并没有获得最新、最好的美国AI芯片，

sentences.en: which up until now were thought to be necessary to build the most powerful models.
sentences.zh: 而在此之前，这些芯片被认为是构建最强大模型所必需的。

sentences.en: A lot of people put a lot of money into AI, and now they're wondering if that money is needed the way that some of these American companies have said it is.
sentences.zh: 很多人在AI上投入了大量资金，现在他们开始怀疑，是否真的需要像其中一些美国公司所说的那样投入那么多资金。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 确实如此。

sentences.en: And so investors start saying, wait a minute, if it only costs $5.5 million to train a leading-edge AI model,
sentences.zh: 因此投资者开始说，等一下，如果训练一个前沿AI模型只需要550万美元，

sentences.en: then what the heck are all these American companies doing spending hundreds of millions of dollars or even billions of dollars to train roughly equivalent models?
sentences.zh: 那所有这些美国公司花几亿甚至几十亿美元去训练大致相当的模型到底在搞什么鬼？

sentences.en: Tech stocks plummeted Monday as investors raised concerns about advancements in Chinese artificial intelligence.
sentences.zh: 由于投资者对中国人工智能进展的担忧，科技股周一暴跌。

sentences.en: And so the stocks of many of the American tech companies start to fall.
sentences.zh: 于是许多美国科技公司的股价开始下跌。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And so after all of this, people in the American tech industry start asking questions.
sentences.zh: 所以在这一切之后，美国科技界的人开始提出疑问。

sentences.en: Like, who is DeepSeek?
sentences.zh: 比如，DeepSeek是谁？

sentences.en: And how are they getting these incredible models with so little money spent on them?
sentences.zh: 他们是怎么花这么少钱就做出这些不可思议的模型的？

sentences.en: Okay, we're going to get to those questions of who this company is and how they did this.
sentences.zh: 好的，我们接下来会探讨这家公司是谁以及他们是如何做到这一点的问题。

sentences.en: But I just first want to dig into the anatomy of the market panic.
sentences.zh: 但首先我想深入剖析市场恐慌的本质。

sentences.en: What are the real fears driving this?
sentences.zh: 驱动这一切的真正恐惧是什么？

sentences.en: So it depends who you ask, because there are a couple kind of overlapping panics that are starting to happen around this time.
sentences.zh: 这取决于你问谁，因为在这个时期周围开始发生几类有些重叠的恐慌。

sentences.en: Of course, again, there's the investor panic.
sentences.zh: 当然，还有投资者恐慌。

sentences.en: I mean, imagine if you had your whole portfolio invested in American AI companies.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，想象一下如果你把整个投资组合都投在了美国AI公司上。

sentences.en: It would be like if you just bought like a very high-end sports car, like a Lamborghini,
sentences.zh: 这就好比你刚买了一辆非常高端的跑车，比如兰博基尼，

sentences.en: and you had been driving it around and were so proud of how fast it could accelerate and how well it handled.
sentences.zh: 你一直开着它，为它的加速有多快、操控有多好而感到无比自豪。

sentences.en: And then like some random guy shows up with like a soapbox car made of balsa wood, and it can go just as fast as your car.
sentences.zh: 然后突然冒出个随机路人，开着一辆用轻木做的肥皂盒赛车，而且它的速度能和你的车一样快。

sentences.en: You'd be like, what the heck?
sentences.zh: 你会觉得，搞什么鬼？

sentences.en: Why did I just spend all this money on this Lamborghini?
sentences.zh: 我为什么刚花大把大把的钱买这辆兰博基尼？

sentences.en: Yeah, and should I maybe be investing in balsa wood cars?
sentences.zh: 对啊，我是不是也该投资轻木赛车？

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And then, of course, there's the geopolitical freakout because DeepSeek is a Chinese AI company.
sentences.zh: 然后，当然还有地缘政治狂热，因为DeepSeek是一家中国的AI公司。

sentences.en: And there has been this race happening between primarily the U.S.
sentences.zh: 多年来，主要是在美国和中国之间，一直存在着一场关于AI和AI霸权主义的竞赛。

sentences.en: and China for years about AI and AI supremacy.
sentences.zh: 谁能比对方率先构建出功能最强大的AI模型？

sentences.en: Who was going to be able to build the most powerful AI models before the other one?
sentences.zh: 对于评估未来军事冲突等事情来说，这是一个非常重要的问题。

sentences.en: And that is a very important question for things like assessing the future of military conflict.
sentences.zh: 如果一个国家的AI比另一个国家的AI好得多，他们可能会占据优势。

sentences.en: If one country's AI is way better than another country's AI, they might have an advantage.
sentences.zh: 事实上，美国正是出于这个原因，

sentences.en: In fact, the U.S.
sentences.zh: 禁止向中国出口功能最强大的AI芯片，

sentences.en: has banned the export of the most powerful AI chips to China for exactly this reason,
sentences.zh: 试图以此来阻挠中国AI公司，防止他们在构建可能变得至关重要最前沿模型时迎头赶上。

sentences.en: to try to sort of hobble the Chinese AI companies to keep them from catching up when it comes to building the bleeding edge models that could become very important.
sentences.zh: 所以，DeepSeek只能将就着用这些“柯克兰签名”级别的芯片，你知道的，它们还行，但不是最好的。

sentences.en: So instead, DeepSeek had to kind of make do with these like Kirkland signature chips that are, you know, pretty good, but they're not the beSt.
sentences.zh: 因此，这与所花费的资金结合起来，真让人不禁发问：他们究竟是怎么做到的？

sentences.en: And so that combined with the amount of money spent really made people say, how did they pull this thing off?
sentences.zh: 凯文，至少从DeepSeek的说法来看，它在这里确实完成了一项相当令人瞩目的壮举。

sentences.en: Kevin, it certainly seems that at least based on what DeepSeek is saying, it has managed to pull off a pretty impressive feat here.
sentences.zh: 但我在想，我们能相信这家公司的话吗？

sentences.en: But I'm wondering, can we trust what the company says?
sentences.zh: 我们能相信他们关于如何做到这一点的说辞吗？

sentences.en: Can we trust their claims about how they pulled this off?
sentences.zh: 是的，所以有很多人对DeepSeek的说法持怀疑态度。

sentences.en: Yeah, so there are a lot of people who are skeptical of what DeepSeek has claimed.
sentences.zh: 特别是模型的成本，550万美元可能并不是真实的数字。

sentences.en: In particular, the cost of the model, $5.5 million might not be the real figure.
sentences.zh: 它不包括所有的研发、工程师薪水以及投入其中的其他成本。

sentences.en: It doesn't include all of the research and the engineer salaries and things that went into that.
sentences.zh: 所以实际成本可能比这要高得多。

sentences.en: So that the real cost is probably significantly higher than that.
sentences.zh: 但也有一些疑问，比如，他们是不是走私了非常强大的芯片，从而真正允许他们构建出这么好的模型？

sentences.en: But there are questions about, you know, did they smuggle in very powerful chips that would have actually allowed them to build a model this good?
sentences.zh: 你知道的，是不是有什么猫腻？

sentences.en: You know, is there something going on?
sentences.zh: 是不是中国政府在向他们注入资金却没告诉我们？

sentences.en: Is the Chinese government funneling money to them and not telling us about it?
sentences.zh: 所以有很多理论。

sentences.en: So there are lots of theories.
sentences.zh: 但随着时间的推移，精通此道的专家们开始深入钻研细节，他们得出的结论是，好吧，

sentences.en: But then as time wears on and people who are experts in this stuff start digging through the details, they're coming to the conclusion that, well, yeah,
sentences.zh: 也许成本确实比DeepSeek声称的要高一点。

sentences.en: maybe the cost is a little higher than DeepSea claiMs.
sentences.zh: 也许他们拥有的芯片比告诉我们的要多一些。

sentences.en: Maybe they have a few more chips than they're telling us about.
sentences.zh: 但总的来说，这看起来他们确实只用了某些非常巧妙的工程技术就构建出了一个非常好的模型。

sentences.en: But in general, this seems like they actually just did build a really good model using some very clever engineering techniques.
sentences.zh: 好的，那我们来谈谈这些工程技术。

sentences.en: Okay, so let's talk about those engineering techniques.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，DeepSeek到底是怎么做到这一点的？

sentences.en: I mean, how actually did DeepSeek do this?
sentences.zh: 在极低预算下，甚至可能用着二流芯片，就做出一个聊天机器人？

sentences.en: Make a chatbot on a shoestring budget, potentially, with second-rate chips?
sentences.zh: 因为我们认为DeepSeek没有获得美国公司正在使用的最强大芯片，

sentences.en: So because DeepSeek did not have access, we don't think, to the most powerful chips that American companies are using,
sentences.zh: 所以他们必须在提高模型效率方面变得更聪明。

sentences.en: they had to kind of get clever about becoming more efficient with their model.
sentences.zh: 我不会用技术细节来烦你。

sentences.en: I won't bore you with the technical details.
sentences.zh: 它包括诸如“混合专家架构”之类的术语。

sentences.en: It includes terms like mixture of experts architecture.
sentences.zh: 但基本上，他们能够利用一些巧妙的诀窍，从他们确实拥有的芯片中榨取最大的算力。

sentences.en: But basically, they were able to use some clever tricks to squeeze the most power out of the chips that they did have.
sentences.zh: 我发现，凯文，这家公司是在诸多限制下运营的。

sentences.en: And it occurs to me, Kevin, that this company was operating under a lot of constraints.
sentences.zh: 听起来这可能迫使工程师们换个角度思考如何解决这个问题。

sentences.en: And it sounds like that may have forced the engineers to think about how to tackle this problem differently.
sentences.zh: 也就是说，没有这些关键要素反而可能孕育了创新。

sentences.en: As in, it seems possible that not having these critical ingredients actually bred innovation.
sentences.zh: 是的，科技界有这样一句名言：限制激发创造力。

sentences.en: Yeah, I mean, there's this saying in the tech industry that constraints inspire creativity.
sentences.zh: 这在这里绝对适用。

sentences.en: And that is definitely true here.
sentences.zh: DeepSeek没有获得美国最好的AI芯片。

sentences.en: DeepSeek did not have access to the best American AI chips.
sentences.zh: 他们没有最庞大的预算或最成熟的团队。

sentences.en: They did not have the largest budget or the most sophisticated team.
sentences.zh: 但他们真的非常机智且富有干劲。

sentences.en: But they were really scrappy and smart.
sentences.zh: 他们有很多非常优秀的年轻工程师。

sentences.en: They had a lot of really good young engineers.
sentences.zh: 他们成功做到了这一点。

sentences.en: And they were able to pull this off.
sentences.zh: 那么，凯文，美国的大型科技公司将如何应对这一点？

sentences.en: So, Kevin, how do the big American tech companies contend with that?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，

sentences.en: I mean,
sentences.zh: 他们对那些怀疑这些公司是否一直在浪费金钱的投资者说些什么，因为这些AI模型的部分工作本可以花少得多的钱完成？

sentences.en: what do they say to investors who are wondering about whether maybe these companies have been throwing money away when some of this work on these AI models could have been done much more cheaply?
sentences.zh: 所以，美国AI公司针对这场市场恐慌的回应是：看，我们仍然必须构建这些庞大、

sentences.en: So, what the AI companies in America are saying in response to this market panic is, look, we've still got to build these big,
sentences.zh: 昂贵的超级计算机，以保持在AI领域的最前沿，拥有最好的模型。

sentences.en: expensive supercomputers to stay at the forefront of AI, to have the best models.
sentences.zh: 如果我们采用DeepSeek现在展示的行之有效的技术，即这些效率提升，我们也能做到。

sentences.en: And if we take the techniques that DeepSeek has now shown are possible, these efficiency gains, we could have them, too.
sentences.zh: 想想看，如果我们把十亿美元投入到DeepSeek以低得多成本制造出的那种模型中，我们的模型将会多么强大。

sentences.en: Think about how powerful our models would be if we put a billion dollars into the same kind of model that DeepSeek was able to make for much less.
sentences.zh: 所以，这就是美国AI公司正在说的话。

sentences.en: So, that is what the American AI companies are saying.
sentences.zh: 但我认为投资者中间确实存在疑问，即他们一直计划的投资规模是否真的有必要。

sentences.en: But I think there are real questions among investors about whether the scale of investment that they have been planning is really necessary.
sentences.zh: 对你来说，凯文，显然你报道这个世界已经很久了。

sentences.en: And for you, Kevin, I mean, obviously you've been covering this world for a very long time.
sentences.zh: 这是否表明，在金钱一直被视为理所当然、被当作必要前提的AI世界里，更多的资金并不一定意味着更多的创新？

sentences.en: Does that show you that more money doesn't necessarily mean more innovation in the world of AI where more money has been kind of a given, you know,
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这是否实际上表明，正如你所说，更小、更有干劲的初创公司可能会在这个领域取得巨大的进展？

sentences.en: as an assumption of what's needed?
sentences.zh: 是的，我认为这动摇了一个基本假设，即只有大玩家才能玩转AI，对吧？

sentences.en: I mean, does it actually suggest that maybe smaller, as you said, scrappier startups could make huge gains in this world?
sentences.zh: 如果你想有机会构建出最先进的AI模型，你就必须是微软、亚马逊或谷歌。

sentences.en: Yeah, I think it threw into question this fundamental assumption that only the big dogs could play in AI, right?
sentences.zh: 我认为DeepSeek的故事表明，外面可能还有全新的一群竞争者试图紧跟前沿，而他们可能不需要世界最大企业之一的资源就能做到这一点。

sentences.en: You had to be Microsoft or Amazon or Google if you wanted a chance to build the state-of-the-art AI models.
sentences.zh: 但其中还有另一个部分，我认为这真正表明AI竞赛已经进入了一个新阶段，

sentences.en: And I think what the DeepSeek story suggested is that there may be a whole other world of competitors out there trying to stay close to the frontier and that they might not have to have the resources of one of the world's largest corporations to do it.
sentences.zh: 那就是DeepSeek做了一件许多美国公司一直犹豫不决的事情，也就是他们将自己的AI模型作为开源软件发布，

sentences.en: But there was one other piece of this that I think really suggests that the AI race has entered a new phase,
sentences.zh: 这意味着互联网上的任何人都可以下载并使用、可以制作自己的版本、可以调整、可以微调。

sentences.en: which is that DeepSeek did something that a lot of American companies have been hesitant to do, which is that they released their AI models as open-source software,
sentences.zh: 它是可以被任何人重复使用、混搭和改进的软件。

sentences.en: meaning that anyone on the internet can download and use, can make their own versions of, can adapt, can tweak.
sentences.zh: 所以当DeepSeek以这种方式发布其模型时，他们确实向世界传递了一个信息，那就是，

sentences.en: It is software that can be reused and remixed and improved upon by anyone.
sentences.zh: 我们是认真对待竞争的，而且我们是如此认真，以至于我们要免费提供我们的模型，以便任何想要的人都可以让它们变得更好。

sentences.en: And so when DeepSeek released its models this way, they really sent a message to the world that says,
sentences.zh: 因此，它突然彻底颠覆了整场AI竞赛，并将其真正推向了一个全新的档次。

sentences.en: we are serious here about competing and we're so serious that we're going to give away our models for free so that anyone who wants to can make them better.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: And so all of a sudden it just flipped the entire AI race onto its head and really sent it into a new gear.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: I'm Wynna Liu.
sentences.zh: 我是温娜·刘。

sentences.en: I write the game Connections, one of the puzzles from New York Times games.
sentences.zh: 我是《纽约时报》游戏板块字谜游戏 Connections 的创作者。

sentences.en: And I love horror movies.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢恐怖电影。

sentences.en: I love my dog.
sentences.zh: 我爱我的狗。

sentences.en: And I love trying to trick you.
sentences.zh: 而且我喜欢尝试捉弄你们。

sentences.en: I'm Sam Mazursky, and I create the game Spelling Bee and Letterboxd on a daily basis.
sentences.zh: 我是萨姆·马祖斯基，我每天创作 Spelling Bee 和 Letterboxd 游戏。

sentences.en: And I have this thing called promesthesia.
sentences.zh: 我有一种叫做色感觉的东西。

sentences.en: I see color when I'm listening to music.
sentences.zh: 当我听音乐时我能看到颜色。

sentences.en: New York Times games are made by people, like the ones you just heard from.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》的游戏是由真人制作的，就像刚才你听到的那些声音一样。

sentences.en: Go to nytimes.com slash games to start playing today.
sentences.zh: 访问 nytimes.com 加上斜杠 games，今天就开始游玩吧。

sentences.en: Kevin, it sounds like DeepSeek has already or is about to really change the landscape of AI.
sentences.zh: 凯文，听上去 DeepSeek 已经或者即将真正改变人工智能的格局。

sentences.en: And my question is, is that good?
sentences.zh: 我的问题是，这是好事吗？

sentences.en: Like for people like you and me, I mean, maybe you more than me, who use chatbots for consumers.
sentences.zh: 比如对于你我这样的人，我是说，也许你比我更多地为日常消费使用聊天机器人的人。

sentences.en: So it's a complicated question to answer because there are ways in which it is probably good and ways in which it is probably bad.
sentences.zh: 所以这是一个复杂的问题，因为在某些方面它可能是好事，而在另一些方面它可能是坏事。

sentences.en: The case that this is a good thing is that, in general, when you make things cheaper, they can be accessible to more people.
sentences.zh: 认为这是一件好事的原因是，总的来说，当你把东西变得更便宜时，更多的人就能使用它们。

sentences.en: I mean, remember, DeepSeek is not just free to use in the app or on the website.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，记住，DeepSeek 不仅在应用程序或网站上免费使用。

sentences.en: It was also released as open source software,
sentences.zh: 它还是作为开源软件发布的，

sentences.en: meaning that anyone with an internet connection can download it and install it on their own computers or maybe tweak it to serve their own purposes.
sentences.zh: 这意味着任何有网络连接的人都可以下载它并安装到自己的计算机上，或者对其进行调整以满足自己的需求。

sentences.en: So if you are a person who wants to use AI, maybe you have a small business or maybe you just want to use this to, you know, help you write letters or emails.
sentences.zh: 所以如果你是一个想使用人工智能的人，也许你有一家小公司，或者你只是想用它来，你知道的，帮你写信件或电子邮件。

sentences.en: Maybe you're a student who wants to use this.
sentences.zh: 也许你是一个想使用它的学生。

sentences.en: You can now access a very powerful model for free.
sentences.zh: 你现在可以免费访问一个非常强大的模型。

sentences.en: Maybe you are a developer or a startup who wants to build your own AI tools.
sentences.zh: 也许你是一个想要构建自己的 AI 工具的开发者或初创公司。

sentences.en: Well, now you have this DeepSeek model that you can kind of take off the shelf as open source software and build your own version of it or run it on your own hardware.
sentences.zh: 好吧，现在你有了这个 DeepSeek 模型，你可以把它作为现成的开源软件拿来构建你自己的版本，或者在自己的硬件上运行它。

sentences.en: And so the people that I talk to in the tech industry who are at startups or smaller companies are very excited about this.
sentences.zh: 所以我在科技行业中交谈过的那些身处初创公司或小公司的人对此感到非常兴奋。

sentences.en: This is a great development for them.
sentences.zh: 这对他们来说是一个巨大的发展。

sentences.en: And it also means that if you are a person who worries that all the AI power is going to go to a few huge companies,
sentences.zh: 这也意味着，如果你是一个担心所有人工智能权力将落入几家大公司手中人，

sentences.en: then the democratization of AI through open source models like DeepSeek probably makes you feel optimistic.
sentences.zh: 那么通过像 DeepSeek 这样的开源模型来实现人工智能的民主化，可能会让你感到乐观。

sentences.en: So that is the positive case for this.
sentences.zh: 这就是积极的一面。

sentences.en: But there are also a lot of people who are really worried about what DeepSeek has done.
sentences.zh: 但也有很多人对 DeepSeek 的所作所为感到非常担忧。

sentences.en: I think the DeepSeek moment has really sparked a lot of new fears about how quickly this whole field of AI is progressing.
sentences.zh: 我认为 DeepSeek 时刻确实引发了人们对整个人工智能领域发展速度的新恐惧。

sentences.en: I mean, just in the last few years,
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，就在过去的几年里，

sentences.en: the leading AI models have gone from maybe being as smart as the average high school student to as smart as a college student to now being able to complete a lot of tasks that would have taken a PhD to complete.
sentences.zh: 领先的人工智能模型已经从智力堪比普通高中生，发展到堪比大学生，而现在能够完成许多需要博士学位才能完成的任务。

sentences.en: So these models are just getting much better very quickly.
sentences.zh: 所以这些模型正在以非常快的速度变得更好。

sentences.en: And a lot of folks in the AI community are just nervous about that.
sentences.zh: 人工智能社区的许多人对此感到紧张。

sentences.en: They say things like, well, maybe we're going to get an AI that is as smart as the smartest humans in just a few years.
sentences.zh: 他们说，也许我们在短短几年内就会得到一个人工智能，它和最聪明的人类一样聪明。

sentences.en: And we don't really have a playbook for dealing with technology that is more intelligent than us.
sentences.zh: 而我们其实并没有应对比我们更智能的技术的方案。

sentences.en: And so there are people who worry about these sort of runaway AI scenarios where you get super intelligent AIs that can sort of take control or maybe even harm humans.
sentences.zh: 因此，有些人担心这种失控的人工智能场景，即你会得到超级智能的人工智能，它们可以接管甚至伤害人类。

sentences.en: But even if you're not a believer in that kind of superhuman intelligence risk, there are just a lot of questions about whether we as a society are ready for advanced AI.
sentences.zh: 但即使你不相信那种超级智能的风险，关于我们作为社会是否准备好迎接先进的人工智能，仍然有很多问题。

sentences.en: Are we ready for the possibility that it could eliminate jobs?
sentences.zh: 我们准备好迎接它可能消除就业岗位的可能性了吗？

sentences.en: Are we ready for the possibility that it could really lead to a proliferation of misinformation or propaganda or even automated cyber attacks and things like that?
sentences.zh: 我们准备好迎接它可能真正导致虚假信息、宣传甚至自动网络攻击等激增的可能性了吗？

sentences.en: So all of that is swirling around the conversation about DeepSeek because we have just accelerated the AI race again.
sentences.zh: 所以所有这些都在围绕着关于 DeepSeek 的对话，因为我们再次加速了人工智能竞赛。

sentences.en: And now it is not just American companies competing with each other over who is in the lead of that race.
sentences.zh: 现在不仅仅是美国公司互相竞争谁在这场竞赛中领先。

sentences.en: Because China has also stepped in and there's a lot of fear and anxiety about what happens if we fall behind.
sentences.zh: 因为中国也介入了，如果落后会发生什么，这引发了很多恐惧和焦虑。

sentences.en: Kevin, if this really is that important of a moment in the global AI arms race, how should we expect the United States to react?
sentences.zh: 凯文，如果这真的是全球人工智能军备竞赛中如此重要的时刻，我们应该期望美国如何反应？

sentences.en: I mean, does the U.S.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，美国

sentences.en: government just ban this thing?
sentences.zh: 政府会直接禁掉这东西吗？

sentences.en: You know, we saw TikTok banned because it was owned by a Chinese company.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，我们看到 TikTok 因为由中国公司拥有而被禁。

sentences.en: Is that the move here?
sentences.zh: 这里的举措会是那样吗？

sentences.en: Well, it may well be because if you're a person who believes that TikTok is a national security threat, there's nothing about DeepSeek that is less of a threat, right?
sentences.zh: 嗯，很可能是这样，因为如果你是一个认为 TikTok 是国家安全威胁的人，DeepSeek 带来的威胁一点也不比它小，对吧？

sentences.en: It is a Chinese company.
sentences.zh: 它是一家中国公司。

sentences.en: It is subject to all the same laws and censorship guidelines as other Chinese software companies are.
sentences.zh: 它受制于与其他中国软件公司完全相同的法律和审查准则。

sentences.en: So, for example, if you ask DeepSeek to tell you what happened at Tiananmen Square or to say something mean about Xi Jinping, the leader of China, it won't do it.
sentences.zh: 所以，例如，如果你让 DeepSeek 告诉你天安门广场发生了什么，或者说一些关于中国领导人习近平的坏话，它是不会做的。

sentences.en: And I would not be surprised if in the coming weeks and months we do see lawmakers in the U.S.
sentences.zh: 如果我们在接下来的几周和几个月里看到美国的立法者

sentences.en: saying, wait a minute, we passed a law to ban TikTok.
sentences.zh: 说，等一下，我们通过了一项法律来禁掉 TikTok。

sentences.en: Why are we not also passing a law to ban DeepSeek?
sentences.zh: 为什么我们不也通过一项法律来禁掉 DeepSeek 呢？

sentences.en: So, I think that's one potential outcome here.
sentences.zh: 所以，我认为这是这里的一个潜在结果。

sentences.en: But there's a key difference, which is that TikTok is not open source software.
sentences.zh: 但有一个关键区别，那就是 TikTok 不是开源软件。

sentences.en: You cannot download TikTok and create your own version of it.
sentences.zh: 你不能下载 TikTok 并创建你自己的版本。

sentences.en: And so, already, the DeepSeek models have been downloaded and recreated all over the world by lots and lots of different people and companies.
sentences.zh: 因此，DeepSeek 模型已经被世界各地许许多多不同的人和公司下载并重新创建了。

sentences.en: And so, I think what the DeepSeek story suggests is that it is going to be quite challenging to contain the spread of powerful AI without some big moves.
sentences.zh: 所以，我认为 DeepSeek 的故事表明，如果不采取重大举措，要遏制强大人工智能的传播将是非常具有挑战性的。

sentences.en: Kevin, if we really are past that point, you know, of containment here, if we're off to the races, does it matter that this innovation happened in China by a Chinese company?
sentences.zh: 凯文，如果我们真的已经过了那个遏制的节点，你知道的，如果我们已经开赛了，这种创新是由一家中国公司在中国发生，这重要吗？

sentences.en: I mean, isn't this bigger than that at this point?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，在这个时候，这难道不比那更宏大吗？

sentences.en: So, there are people in the American tech scene who are calling this DeepSeek moment the Sputnik moment for the AI race.
sentences.zh: 因此，美国科技界有人将这个 DeepSeek 时刻称为人工智能竞赛的“斯普特尼克时刻”。

sentences.en: Because just as the launch of Sputnik by the Soviet Union kicked off the 20th century space race and created sort of profound fear and anxiety among Western nations about whether they were behind their biggest political adversary when it came to technology.
sentences.zh: 因为正如苏联发射“斯普特尼克”卫星开启了 20 世纪的太空竞赛，并在西方国家中引发了对在技术方面是否落后于最大政治对手的深刻恐惧和焦虑一样，

sentences.en: A lot of people are looking at this moment with DeepSeek as kicking off a new era in the AI race where we really want to stay ahead of China.
sentences.zh: 许多人将 DeepSeek 的这个时刻视为人工智能竞赛新时代的开始，在这个时代我们确实想保持领先于中国。

sentences.en: And there are people who say that having a lead in AI, if you are the United States, even if it's just a lead of a couple months or a couple years over your political adversaries,
sentences.zh: 有些人说，如果你是美国，在人工智能方面保持领先，即使只是领先你的政治对手几个月或几年，

sentences.en: is very important.
sentences.zh: 也是非常重要的。

sentences.en: And that may be true, but people who study AI, people who look at this industry closely, who are paying attention to the trends in AI,
sentences.zh: 这可能是真的，但研究人工智能的人，密切关注这个行业的人，一直在关注人工智能趋势的人，

sentences.en: believed that these models would become cheaper and cheaper over time, as well as becoming more powerful over time.
sentences.zh: 原本就相信随着时间的推移，这些模型会变得越来越便宜，同时也变得更强大。

sentences.en: So, this really fits neatly with a lot of what people had been predicting for years.
sentences.zh: 所以这确实与人们多年来一直在预测的许多情况非常契合。

sentences.en: Now, they might not have predicted that this sort of moment would happen from a Chinese AI company.
sentences.zh: 现在，他们可能没有预测到这种时刻会由一家中国人工智能公司产生。

sentences.en: They might not have predicted exactly what the breakthroughs would be that allowed for the models to get cheaper.
sentences.zh: 他们可能没有准确预测出能够让模型变得更便宜的会是哪些突破。

sentences.en: But this is in keeping with the overall trend in AI that we have seen over the past few years, which is that the models keep getting better and they keep getting more efficient.
sentences.zh: 但这符合我们在过去几年中看到的整个人工智能总体趋势，即模型不断变好，效率不断提高。

sentences.en: In a way, it kind of follows the normal progression of any new product, right?
sentences.zh: 从某种意义上说，它有点遵循任何新产品的正常发展进程，对吧？

sentences.en: Like, at first it's expensive and then more and more competition leads to innovation, the thing gets cheaper, everything becomes more democratized.
sentences.zh: 比如，起初它很贵，然后越来越多的竞争带来创新，东西变得更便宜，一切都变得更加民主化。

sentences.en: Yeah, so that is what happened here, but just maybe a little faster than people had expected.
sentences.zh: 是的，所以这里发生的就是这样，只是可能比人们预期的要快一点。

sentences.en: But I think the larger point is that these systems are now improving so rapidly and in so many places all at once that I think it is only a matter of time before nearly everyone in the world has access to very powerful AI models.
sentences.zh: 但我认为更重要的一点是，这些系统现在正在以如此惊人的速度在如此多的地方同时改进，我认为世界上几乎每个人都能用上非常强大的人工智能模型，只是时间问题。

sentences.en: And I just think that world looks a lot different than the one we live in today.
sentences.zh: 而且我只是觉得那个世界与我们今天生活的世界有很大不同。

sentences.en: Kevin, thank you so much.
sentences.zh: 凯文，非常感谢。

sentences.en: Thanks for having me.
sentences.zh: 谢谢邀请我来。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天还需要了解的其他新闻。

sentences.en: On Saturday, President Trump declared tariffs of 25 percent on all goods from Canada and Mexico, with a partial carve-out for Canadian energy and oil exports.
sentences.zh: 周六，特朗普总统宣布对来自加拿大和墨西哥的所有商品征收 25% 的关税，其中对加拿大的能源和石油出口有部分豁免。

sentences.en: He also announced an additional 10 percent tariff on products coming in from China.
sentences.zh: 他还宣布对来自中国的商品额外征收 10% 的关税。

sentences.en: The tariffs are set to take effect at 12.01 a.m.
sentences.zh: 这些关税定于美国东部时间

sentences.en: Eastern Time on Tuesday and have raised concerns of an escalating trade war with America's largest trading partners.
sentences.zh: 周二凌晨 1 点 01 分生效，并引发了人们对与美国最大贸易伙伴升级贸易战的担忧。

sentences.en: Those countries responded swiftly to Trump's announcement.
sentences.zh: 这些国家对特朗普的宣布作出了迅速回应。

sentences.en: The Canadian government detailed its own retaliatory 25 percent tariffs on more than $100 billion worth of U.S.
sentences.zh: 加拿大政府详细列出了其对价值超过 1000 亿美元的美国

sentences.en: goods, including everything from American-made honey, tomatoes and whiskey, to refrigerators and toilets.
sentences.zh: 商品实施报复性 25% 关税的计划，其中包括从美国制造的蜂蜜、西红柿和威士忌，到冰箱和马桶等一切商品。

sentences.en: President Claudia Sheinbaum of Mexico said she would unveil her country's response on Monday,
sentences.zh: 墨西哥总统克劳迪娅·谢因鲍姆表示，她将在周一公布其国家的应对措施，

sentences.en: while China's commerce ministry promised to bring a legal case at the World Trade Organization and, quote, corresponding countermeasures.
sentences.zh: 而中国商务部则承诺将在世界贸易组织提起法律诉讼，并采取“相应的反制措施”。

sentences.en: President Trump acknowledged on social media that his tariffs could cause, quote, some pain, but said it would be, quote, worth the price that must be paid.
sentences.zh: 特朗普总统在社交媒体上承认，他的关税可能会带来“一些痛苦”，但表示这“绝对物有所值”。

sentences.en: And in a new effort to tighten the immigration system, the Trump administration is ending temporary protected status for 300,000 Venezuelan migrants in the United States,
sentences.zh: 根据《时报》获得的一份政府文件，为了收紧移民系统，特朗普政府将结束对美国 30 万委内瑞拉移民的临时保护身份。

sentences.en: according to government documents obtained by The Times.
sentences.zh: 此举可能使这些移民在未来几个月内面临被驱逐出境的风险。

sentences.en: The move could make those migrants vulnerable to potential deportation in the coming months.
sentences.zh: 临时保护身份的指定旨在保护逃离祖国危险局势的移民。

sentences.en: The designation of temporary protected status was meant to protect migrants fleeing dangerous situations in their home countries.
sentences.zh: 但共和党批评人士表示，这让移民在美国停留的时间远远超过了原计划。

sentences.en: But Republican critics have said it allowed migrants to stay in the United States for much longer than intended.
sentences.zh: 今天的节目由香农·林恩、克莱尔·塔尼斯凯特、亚历克斯·斯特恩和凯特琳·奥基夫制作，威尔·里德提供了帮助。

sentences.en: Today's episode was produced by Shannon Lynn, Claire Tannisketter, Alex Stern and Caitlin O'Keefe, with help from Will Reed.
sentences.zh: 节目由马克·乔治和克里斯·哈克塞尔编辑，佩奇·科维特提供了帮助。

sentences.en: It was edited by Mark George and Chris Haxel, with help from Paige Cowett.
sentences.zh: 包含帕特·麦克库斯克、马里安·洛萨诺和丹·鲍威尔的原创音乐，由艾莉莎·莫克斯利工程制作。

sentences.en: Contains original music by Pat McCusker, Marion Lozano and Dan Powell, and was engineered by Alyssa Moxley.

sentences.zh: 几十年来，布鲁克林民主党一直作为一个严格控制的机器运作。

sentences.en: For decades, the Brooklyn Democratic Party operated as a tightly controlled machine.
sentences.zh: 直到今年夏天。

sentences.en: Until this summer.
sentences.zh: 当时选举迎来了群自称改革派的人。

sentences.en: When elections ushered in a bunch of self-described reformers.
sentences.zh: 从那以后，该党一直陷入一场痛苦、混乱有时甚至令人兴奋的斗争中。

sentences.en: Ever since, the party has been in the grip of a bruising, chaotic, and sometimes thrilling fight.
sentences.zh: 在《都市》的最新一期节目中，我和萨拉·柯尼格一起，讲述了人们试图保持影响力却在这个过程中失控的故事。

sentences.en: In the latest episode of Metro, with me, Sarah Koenig, stories of people trying to maintain their influence and losing control along the way.
